gold: If all primes were bounded by n, a prime divisor of n! + 1 would both divide n! and divide n! + 1, hence divide 1, impossible; so the primes are infinite .

gold: If there were only finitely many primes, the Euler product over all of them would be fixed. But the product over primes below a sufficiently large bound dominates arbitrarily large harmonic sums , a contradiction.

def F3 : Prop := ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p > n

def F4 (n : ℕ) : ℕ := 2 ^ (2 ^ n) + 1

lemma F5 (n : ℕ) : F4 n ≥ 2 := by
  have : 1 ≤ 2 ^ (2 ^ n) := Nat.one_le_two_pow
  F6 F4; F7

lemma F8 (n : ℕ) : F9 (F4 n) := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.two_pow_pos n).F10
  exact ⟨2 ^ k, by F6 F4; rw [hk, F11]; ring⟩

lemma F12 (n : ℕ) :
    F4 (n + 1) = ∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), F4 k + 2 := by
  have F13 : ∀ m, ∏ k ∈ Finset.range m, F4 k = F4 m - 2 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih, F4, F4, F14,
          (show 2 ^ 2 ^ m + 1 - 2 = 2 ^ 2 ^ m - 1 by F7), ← Nat.sq_sub_sq]
      ring_nf
      F7
  rw [F13, Nat.sub_add_cancel (F5 _)]

lemma F15 (n : ℕ) :
    (F4 (n + 1)).F16 (∏ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), F4 k) := by
  rw [F12 n, F17, Nat.coprime_add_self_left, Nat.coprime_two_left]
  exact Finset.prod_induction _ F9 (fun _ _ => F18) F19
    (fun k _ => F8 k)

lemma F20 : F21 (fun m n => (F4 m).F16 (F4 n)) := by
  intro m n hmn
  F22 h : m < n with H
  · exact (H hmn.symm (by F7)).F23
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by F7⟩
  exact (F15 k).F24
    (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by F7)))

theorem F25 : F1 := by
  apply Set.infinite_of_injective_forall_mem (f := fun n => (F4 n).F26)
  · intro m n (h : (F4 m).F26 = (F4 n).F26)
    by_contra hmn
    have hp : (F4 m).F27 :=

def F3 : Prop := ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p > n

def a : ℕ → ℕ
  | 0 => 2
  | n + 1 => a n * (a n + 1)

lemma F4 : ∀ n, 2 ≤ a n
  | 0 => F5
  | n + 1 => (Nat.mul_le_mul (F4 n) (by F6 : 1 ≤ a n + 1)).F7 rfl

lemma F8 (n : ℕ) : n + 1 ≤ (a n).F9 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [a, Nat.Prime.primeFactors Nat.prime_two]
  | succ n ih =>
    have h2 := F4 n
    have hpos : 1 ≤ (a n + 1).F9 :=
      Finset.card_pos.mpr (Nat.nonempty_primeFactors.mpr (by F6))
    have hco : Nat.Coprime (a n) (a n + 1) := by simp [Nat.Coprime]
    rw [show a (n + 1) = a n * (a n + 1) from rfl, Nat.primeFactors_mul (by F6) (by F6),
      Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hco.disjoint_primeFactors]
    F6

theorem F10 : F1 := fun hfin => by
  have h1 : (a hfin.toFinset.card).F9 ≤ hfin.toFinset.card :=
    Finset.card_le_card fun _ hp => hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hp)
  have h2 := F8 hfin.toFinset.card
  F6

lemma F4 : Nat.fib 37 = 73 * 149 * 2221 := by simp [Nat.fib]

lemma F5 {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) : 2 ≤ Nat.fib p :=
  calc 2 = Nat.fib 3 := by decide
    _ ≤ Nat.fib p := Nat.fib_mono (hp.two_le.lt_or_eq.resolve_right (Ne.symm hp2))

lemma F6 {p q : ℕ}

    Nat.Coprime (Nat.fib p) (Nat.fib q) := by
  rw [Nat.Coprime, ← Nat.fib_gcd, (Nat.coprime_primes hp hq).F7 hpq]; rfl

theorem F8 : F1 := fun hfin => by
  set S := hfin.toFinset
  have h2S : 2 ∈ S := hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr Nat.prime_two
  have h37S : 37 ∈ S := hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr (by decide)
  set T := S.erase 2
  have h37T : 37 ∈ T := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨by decide, h37S⟩

    hfin.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hp)
  have hf37 : 3 ≤ (Nat.fib 37).F10 := by
    have : (Nat.fib 37).F11 = {73, 149, 2221} := by
      rw [F4, Nat.primeFactors_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num),
          Nat.primeFactors_mul (by norm_num) (by norm_num),
          Nat.Prime.primeFactors (by norm_num : (73 : ℕ).F12),
          Nat.Prime.primeFactors (by norm_num : (149 : ℕ).F12),
          Nat.Prime.primeFactors (by norm_num : (2221 : ℕ).F12)]
      rfl
    rw [this]; decide
  have hpwd : (T : Set ℕ).F13 (fun p => (Nat.fib p).F11) :=
    fun p hp q hq hpq => Nat.Coprime.disjoint_primeFactors
      (F6 (F9 p hp) (F9 q hq) hpq)
  have F14 : ∑ p ∈ T, (Nat.fib p).F10 ≤ S.card := by
    rw [← Finset.card_biUnion hpwd]
    exact Finset.card_le_card fun q hq =>
      let ⟨p, _, hqp⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hq
      hfin.mem_toFinset.mpr (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors hqp)
  have F15 := (Finset.add_sum_erase T (fun p => (Nat.fib p).F10) h37T).F16
  have F17 : (T.erase 37).F18 ≤ ∑ p ∈ T.erase 37, (Nat.fib p).F10 := by
    rw [Finset.card_eq_sum_ones]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun p hp =>

      Finset.card_pos.mpr (Nat.nonempty_primeFactors.mpr

  have F19 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem h2S
  have F20 := Finset.card_erase_of_mem h37T
  have F21 : 1 ≤ S.card := Finset.one_le_card.mpr ⟨2, h2S⟩
  have F22 : 1 ≤ T.card := Finset.one_le_card.mpr ⟨37, h37T⟩
